summary.intent: Fix a GitHub Actions release-gate workflow bug where polling incorrectly picks an in-progress rerun over a completed run, then address CodeRabbit review feedback on the same PR.
summary.outcome: Applied sort_by fix to prefer completed runs for both web and desktop polling, resolved 2 PR threads, pushed commit 243f6e4, then applied 3 additional CodeRabbit fixes to release-gate.yml in a follow-up commit.

repo: cipher-box uses a release-gate.yml workflow with separate web and desktop polling logic that share the same rerun-ordering bug pattern
PR reviews come from both GitHub Copilot and CodeRabbit; CodeRabbit may produce differently formatted output

code.finding: Polling logic must use sort_by(.status == "completed" | not) to prefer completed runs over in-progress reruns — applies to both web and desktop polling sections
DESKTOP_SUCCESS vs DESKTOP_TOTAL comparison had a separate issue flagged by CodeRabbit requiring a fix alongside the sort_by changes

workflow: Reply-and-resolve PR threads via Bash tooling in a single session to keep review state clean
CodeRabbit reviews may arrive after Copilot and require a separate fix pass; batch all actionable items into one commit

friction: CodeRabbit review formatting differed from expected format, requiring the user to flag it explicitly before processing
